The game is in INDEV! there will be glitches, resets, updates, and missing features.
--Inspired by Spore, Thrive, Rain World, as well as other ecosystem and/or life building games!--

Credit to: Rambuthan, Helfire_Arrow, and my staff team, couldn't have done this without all of you ❤️‍🩹

Shooting - M1
Dribble - E
Tackle - Q
Abilities - 1 2 3 4
Awaken - G
Sidedash - Q + A/D
Sprint - F (without ball)

Headers - Jump + Jump
Chest Traps - Jump meanwhile ball is coming towards you
